title: 第十七章 奖励到账青云秘境开启第十八章 趋吉避凶青丹殿前杀局现
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
魂审之后，周荒终于领到了外门小比第一的奖励。
不过在领奖之前，他先在执法堂偏房昏睡了半个时辰。
护脉丹的药力护住经脉，却压不住战意沸腾后的反噬。
醒来时，内衫已被冷汗浸透，肩头伤口也重新裂开。
周荒没有抱怨。
能以炼气七层打倒韩无极，本就是拿半条命换来的赢。
下品灵石三千块。
上品法器青木离火剑一柄。
二品聚灵丹三枚。
青云秘境名额一枚。
甲字下等洞府三月使用权。
当这些东西摆在面前时，周荒心里只有一个念头。
难怪人人都想往上爬。
资源、功法、法器、洞府。
只要你赢，它们便会主动来到你手中。
以前他在废丹房里翻烂泥，一天累死累活也未必能摸到一块灵石。
现在赢一场小比，三千灵石到手。
这就是修仙界。
强者吃肉，弱者连汤碗都碰不到。
周荒先收起青木离火剑。

此剑通体青赤，剑脊有木纹，灌入灵力后可燃离火，比乌鳞残剑强了不知多少。
有它在，秘境里遇到炼气九层，他至少有正面接招的资格。
不过那柄断剑他也没丢。
废物先留着。
万一下次刷到变废为宝，说不定能给自己一个惊喜。
搬入甲字洞府后，周荒立刻感到灵气浓度翻了数倍。
聚灵阵开启的一瞬，火木双灵根便像饿了许久的鱼，疯狂吞吐灵气。
他没有急着冲境，而是先检查自身。
小比一战临阵突破炼气七层，看似爽快，实则经脉负担不轻。
若不稳固，日后筑基会留隐患。
他花五百灵石买护脉丹，又买三张二阶下品符箓。
金光盾符，疾风遁符，爆炎符。
东西贵得肉疼，却能在关键时刻救命。
此外，他又去藏功阁，把小比第一额外借阅机会用在《青云秘境杂记》上。
书里记载，青云秘境原是某个古修宗门药园，后来宗门覆灭，空间碎裂，被鹤咏仙门先祖固定下来。
里面灵药多，妖兽多，残阵也多。
最重要的是，秘境深处曾有一座青丹殿。
据说那里藏着筑基丹古方。
周荒看到这里，心跳快了几分。
筑基丹，他手里已有一枚圆满级。

若再得到古方与灵药，日后筑基的把握便更大。
他没有急着服用筑基丹。
炼气七层距离筑基还远，此时强冲只会浪费至宝。
content_en:
After the soul trial, Zhou Huang finally received the reward for ranking first in the outer sect competition.
But before receiving the award, he fell asleep in the side room of the law enforcement hall for half an hour.
The medicinal power of the Pulse Protecting Pill protects the meridians, but it cannot suppress the backlash after the fighting spirit boils over.
When I woke up, my underwear was soaked with cold sweat, and the wound on my shoulder had reopened.
Zhou Huang didn't complain.
Being able to defeat Han Wuji with the seventh level of Qi Refining was a victory that cost half his life.
Three thousand pieces of low-grade spiritual stone.
A top-grade magical weapon, the Qingmu Lihuo Sword.
Three second-grade spirit-gathering pills.
One quota for Qingyun Secret Realm.
The right to use the lower-level caves in three months.
When these things were placed in front of him, Zhou Huang had only one thought in his mind.
No wonder everyone wants to move up the ladder.
Resources, techniques, magical tools, and caves.
As long as you win, they will come to you.
In the past, he was digging through the mud in the waste alchemy room, and he might not be able to touch a spiritual stone even after a tiring day.
Now if you win a small competition, you will get three thousand spirit stones.
This is the world of immortality.
The strong eat meat, the weak cannot even touch the soup bowl.
Zhou Huang first put away the Qingmu Lihuo Sword.
This sword is completely green and red, with wood grains on the spine. It can be ignited by fire after being injected with spiritual power. It is much stronger than the Black Scale Broken Sword.
With it here, when he encounters the ninth level of Qi Refining in the secret realm, he is at least qualified to accept the attack head-on.
But he didn't lose the broken sword either.
Keep the waste first.
If you turn waste into treasure next time, you might be able to give yourself a surprise.
After moving into the Jiazi Cave Mansion, Zhou Huang immediately felt that the concentration of spiritual energy had increased several times.
The moment the spirit gathering array was opened, the fire and wood spiritual roots were like fish that had been hungry for a long time, swallowing spiritual energy crazily.
He didn't rush into the situation, but checked himself first.
Xiao Bi broke through the seventh level of Qi refining before the battle. It seemed refreshing, but in fact, the burden on his meridians was heavy.
If it is not stable, there will be hidden dangers in future foundation construction.
He spent five hundred spirit stones to buy a pulse-protecting pill and three second-level low-grade talismans.
The Golden Light Shield Talisman, the Wind Escape Talisman, and the Explosive Flame Talisman.
Things are painfully expensive, but they can save lives at critical moments.
In addition, he went to the Zanggong Pavilion and used Xiao Bi's extra borrowing opportunity to read "Miscellaneous Notes of Qingyun Secret Realm".
It is recorded in the book that Qingyun Secret Realm was originally the medicine garden of an ancient cultivating sect. Later, the sect was destroyed and the space was fragmented. It was fixed by the ancestors of Heyong Xianmen.
There are many elixirs, many monsters and beasts, and many residual formations inside.
The most important thing is that there was a Qingdan Palace deep in the secret realm.
It is said that the ancient foundation-building elixir is hidden there.
When Zhou Huang saw this, his heart beat a little faster.
He already has a Perfect Level Establishment Pill in his hand.
If we get more ancient prescriptions and elixirs, we will be more confident about building foundations in the future.
He was not in a hurry to take the Foundation Establishment Pill.
The seventh level of Qi Refining is still far away from the foundation building, so charging at this time will only waste the treasure.
